{"sections": {"overview": "Case erector: takes flat corrugated cases from a magazine, opens them, folds the bottom minor and major flaps and tapes the bottom, then sends the case out on a powered roller conveyor. Replaces two operators. Target 10 cases per minute.", "sequence": "- Wait for a case at the front of the magazine.
- Opener arm (air cylinder with suction cups) extends to the case, vacuum on, wait for vacuum OK.
- Opener retracts, pulling the case open; wait for opener retracted.
- Minor flap cylinders extend to fold the small flaps; wait for flaps folded.
- Vacuum off; pusher cylinder extends and pushes the case through the mechanical tape head (folds the major flaps and tapes the bottom); wait for pusher extended.
- Pusher and flap cylinders retract; wait for pusher retracted.
- Outfeed roller conveyor runs continuously in Auto and carries the case away; the tape-head exit photo-eye must clear within 5 s.
- Count every case that leaves the tape head.", "safety": "- One E-stop on the operator panel, dual channel into a safety relay; safety relay status to the PLC.
- Interlocked guard doors around the machine into the same safety relay: opening any door stops everything (stop category 0), air is dumped.
- Loss of safety stops the conveyor, turns off vacuum and all valves.", "guarding": "- Guard doors on all sides with interlock switches (series into the safety relay). Door open: machine stops, no restart until doors closed and Reset pressed.", "homing": "- At power-up and after a reset all cylinders are retracted (single solenoid, spring return). Auto can start only with the opener and pusher retracted and safety OK.", "modes": "- Auto and Manual from the HMI. Manual: each cylinder and the vacuum can be cycled by hand from the HMI for setup.", "motion": "- M1 outfeed roller conveyor, 0.5 HP (assumed), 480 VAC 3-phase, across-the-line contactor with overload.", "pneumatics": "- Opener cylinder with suction cups: single 5/2 solenoid, extended and retracted sensors.
- Vacuum generator: solenoid valve, vacuum switch (vacuum OK).
- Minor flap fold cylinders (2, one valve): single solenoid, folded sensor.
- Pusher cylinder: single 5/2 solenoid, extended and retracted sensors.
- Air dump valve controlled by the safety relay.", "sensing": "- Magazine low sensor (about 10 cases left), PNP.
- Case present at the magazine front, PNP.
- Tape head exit photo-eye (jam detection and count), PNP.", "operator": "- Panel: E-stop, Start (green), Stop (red, NC), Reset (blue).
- Stack light red / amber / green.
- 7" touch screen: case count and rate, alarms, manual cylinder controls.", "alarms": "- Case not opened: vacuum OK missing within 2 s.
- Opener / pusher / flap cylinder timeout (3 s).
- Jam at the tape head: exit photo-eye blocked longer than 5 s.
- Magazine low (warning, amber light).
- Conveyor motor overload.
- Reset from the panel or HMI after the cause is cleared.", "utilities": "480 VAC 3-phase, 60 Hz. Plant air 80 psi. NEMA 12 enclosure. US, UL 508A / NFPA 79.", "other": ""}, "questions": ["What is the outfeed conveyor motor size?", "Single case size or several case sizes (changeover)?", "Should the outfeed conveyor stop when a downstream line is full?"], "summary": "Organized the case erector description into sections; assumed a 0.5 HP outfeed conveyor and single-solenoid spring-return valves."}
